crossRefs.note: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full…
For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.
For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory…
Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by…
My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.
I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn…
Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called…
Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to…
I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.
He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land, and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise…
“Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be…
The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,
For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

translations.web: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”
translations.bsb: The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former, says the LORD of Hosts. And in this place I will provide peace, declares the LORD of Hosts.”
translations.kjv: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.
translations.asv: The latter glory of this house shall be greater than the former, saith Jehovah of hosts; and in this place will I give peace, saith Jehovah of hosts.
